name: council
description: Convene a council of advisors on a question or on a repo's recent work: built-in members plus your own member files, chosen per project, with animated pixel portraits and a brain trust mode.

briefModel.title: Review model
briefModel.description: Model that briefs the council in review mode (/council review <ref>): picks files, then writes the brief.

advisorModel.title: Advisor model
advisorModel.description: Model of the five advisors (plain model calls, not agents).

deepModel.title: Brain trust model
deepModel.description: Model for every call of a brain trust (/council deep): advisors, reconsiderations, follow-ups, the report, and review mode's herald. E.g. opus or fable.

deepEffort.title: Brain trust effort
deepEffort.description: Effort for every brain trust call.

triageModel.title: Court triage model
triageModel.description: In court mode, the model that decides whether a prompt goes to the council (changes, risks, decisions) or straight to Claude (questions, chatter).

arbiter.title: Arbiter
arbiter.description: The id of one seated member (its member file's name, e.g. hand) who reviews the conditions on an approved plan of orders: one low-effort call on the advisor model keeps or drops each. Leave empty for none: every condition stands.

callTally.title: Work along the road
callTally.description: In the court, draw each order's todos as stops along its road: a stack of bricks on each finished todo (one brick per ten tool calls made on it, up to five, the fifth with a banner), and a red enemy tent on each todo not yet started. Off leaves the plain road.

scoutLevels.title: Scout levels
scoutLevels.description: What a scout runs on at each level the council gives its order (1, 2, 3): three model:effort entries, comma-separated; the model an alias (haiku, sonnet, opus) or a full id. Effort is left alone for a model that takes none.

knightLevels.title: Knight levels
knightLevels.description: What a knight runs on at each level the council gives its order (1, 2, 3): three model:effort entries, comma-separated.

advisorAgentLevels.title: Advisor agent levels
advisorAgentLevels.description: The read-only advisor agent (council:advisor), not the members: two model:effort entries, for /council advise (and a council summons) and for /council advise deep.

councilSummons.title: Council summons
councilSummons.description: When a member's concern on a plan of orders hinges on a fact it can't see, it may ask a CHECK question; the council then sends one read-only advisor agent (the first advisor agent level) to the plan's folders and rules again on its findings. At most one per ruling. Off: CHECK questions are ignored.

amendmentsPerOrder.title: Amendments per order
amendmentsPerOrder.description: How many amendments Claude may ask for on one council order under way (mcp__council__amend_order), refused ones included; each is ruled on by the council. 0 turns amendments off. Whole numbers 0 to 10.

leaveApproval.title: Leave approval
leaveApproval.description: Who grants a knight order's leave (exceptions to the default rules of the sidekick mod's policy judge, asked in the proposal and ruled on with the plan). owner: the order can't be dispatched until you type /council grant <order> (or /council deny-leave <order> to send it without). council: granted when the council approves the plan.
